title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 Powers New Class of AI-Native Storage Infrastructure
supports: Inference Context Memory Storage Platform announced at CES: a BlueField-4-fronted flash storage layer that extends KV cache capacity and shares context across rack-scale systems; KV placement in hardware; integrated with DOCA, NIXL and Dynamo (via search snippet)

title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 press release (syndicated)

title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 press release (syndicated)

title: Inference Context Memory Storage (ICMS): Why AI inference is becoming a problem only flash can solve

title: Research note: NVIDIA's Inference Context Memory Storage Platform

title: LiveMind: Low-latency Large Language Models with Simultaneous Inference

title: Why Prefill has Become the Bottleneck in Inference and How Augmented Memory Grid Helps

title: MHA2MLA: Towards Economical Inference by Enabling DeepSeek's Multi-Head Latent Attention in Any Transformer-based LLMs
supports: Llama2-7B (MHA) KV cache reduced 92.19% with 0.5% LongBench drop using partial-RoPE removal + SVD low-rank; uses 0.3-0.6% of pretraining data (via search snippet)
